entries.name: Bill Tilton

expected.charges: Interfering with the Selective Service System (the July 1970 Minnesota draft-board raids).
expected.sentence: Verdict as recorded: Convicted; most sentenced to five years and released July 1973.

entries.rationale: Minnesota Historical Society oral history printed page 104 explicitly asks actual time served, answered twenty months. Preserve source units; no inferred day count or admission date. Existing July 1973 release month preserved.

entries.name: Andrés Figueroa Cordero

expected.charges: Assault with intent to kill (5 counts).
expected.sentence:
75 years + 6 years = 81 years

Charges as recorded: Assault with intent to kill (5 counts) for the March 1, 1954 armed attack on the U.S. House of Representatives, in which four Puerto Rican Nationalists fired ~30 rounds from the Ladies' Gallery, wounding five congressmen. Additional 6-year sentence under Smith Act for seditious conspiracy (October 1954). Defendants refused parole conditions requiring renunciation of Puerto Rican independence. Sentences commuted by President Carter in 1977-1979.

entries.rationale: House history and March 1 police-custody photograph establish March 1 detention; March 2 AP reports continued prisoner status. Correct pre-event February 28 dates. October 7 report confirms actual release October 6, 1977. Admission represents custody commencement, not arrival at later penitentiary.

entries.name: Cesar Chavez

expected.charges: Two counts of contempt of court
expected.sentence:
Held in the Monterey County Jail in Salinas for 14 days; $500 fine on each of two counts. (One of multiple jailings across his organizing life.)

Verdict as recorded: Yes — Monterey County Superior Court, December 4, 1970; California Supreme Court ordered his release on Christmas Eve

Charges as recorded: Two counts of contempt of court — refusing to comply with a Monterey County Superior Court injunction against the United Farm Workers Organizing Committee's national consumer boycott of Bud Antle lettuce

updates.sentence:

entries.rationale: LOC chronology, NPS history, and contemporary Congressional Record establish December 4, 1970 remand.
